name: Conformational ring flip of [2.2]metaparacyclophane-d

reference.citation: S. A. Sherrod, V. Boekelheide, J. Am. Chem. Soc. 1972, 94, 5513-5515
reference.method: conformational KIE of the ring flip, 308 K

reference.citation: S. A. Sherrod, R. L. da Costa, R. A. Barnes, V. Boekelheide, J. Am. Chem. Soc. 1974, 96, 1565-1577
reference.method: steric isotope effect and other steric effects in [2.2]metaparacyclophanes

reference.citation: G. Grazioli, A. Ly, D. Sabetnejad, A. Mattapalli, C. T. Nguyen, D. J. O'Leary, PyQuiverHS: A Web Tool for Computing Isotope Effects, ChemRxiv 2026 (preprint, CC-BY 4.0)
reference.method: source of the frequency calculations (SI data, Gaussian 16) and of the experimental value(s) quoted here, from Table 5 and section 3.2 (308 K); its PyQuiverHS results for the same files are in pyquiverhs/

notes: Compound 3 of Grazioli et al.; the measured value is the one quoted in their section 3.2. The single deuterium (atom 27) is the internal hydrogen of the meta-bridged ring, which is squeezed across the face of the para-bridged ring during the ring flip. Their Table 5 labels the column 3-d8, but the text and the PyQuiverHS input have one deuterium.
